[b]Special Military Operation [/b]

To end Goleornacha's funding to Sal Baliz, the government of Camphill gave the military orders to attack crucial military headquarters, and bases, in Goleornacha in order to cripple Goleornacha's military at least for a little bit. Camphill's government gives them an ultimatum. If you continue to fund Sal Baliz, this war will continue, if you stop, we'll stop hurting your army. 

[Sorry for how short it is, I'm still working on it.]
Why is there a war happening just outside my shores?

[quote=irocco;58812373][i]The Iroccan diplomatic envoys step off the plane, Diplomat Isfan greeted the initial group who were to transport them to the representative of High Council of Sikirsk. He tried to keep small talk to a minimum and request they take him to the Representative as soon as possible mumbling something about his wife missing him.[/i][/quote]

[b][i]Transported in convoy, you arrive at the main "government" building. You arrive, you are greeted by Drifttopia, and a other fellow from the Council.[/i][/b]

Welcome to Sikirsk my friend, make yourself at home, we are happy to start interacting with your great nation. Interested in some Sikirskian Wine?

[quote=irocco;58805984][i]Irman looked the man up and down before nodding and bowing in kind. "Correct." He walked off toward the great marble door of the palace, carved upon it was the Shahada which itself was emblazoned with foreign gold. As he walked the halls, stepping upon a fine Iroccan carpet, passing by the artworks of the long past golden age a faint smile grew upon his face. Guards littered the Palace, each of them well equipped to ensure the safety of the Sealiph who had done so much good in the name of the state and Allah. Soon enough they reached a grand hall decorated with calligraphy and artworks much like the hallway they had just walked through.

In a corner there was a grand library, each book's cover seemed ancient and well worn. And there was the throne, it was simple, more of a chair than a grand throne. It was covered in pillows, more for the comfort of the aging man who sat upon it than the prestige which thrones are normally used for. Upon it sat the Sealiph, his face well worn and wrinkled, his grey beard stretching to his chest and his bushy eyebrows furrowed as they entered. He looked so small upon that seat, though that did not change his regality. A fine turban upon his head and a silk robe draped over his body, with a great cape that was edged in fur finishing off his look.

He extended his hand out toward the visitors. "Unto my home came a visitor from alien lands, with dignity I granted him access and spoke to him like a brother lost to time." A seat was swiftly fetched for Chul if he wished to take it. Irman placed himself next to the door. Ever watching ever vigilant.[/i][/quote]
[i]Chul refused the seat, in Pantagrueli culture it was sign of disrespect to be sitting down while speaking to someone of high nobility. He swiftly re-adjusted the badges of his regalia to a more appropriate manner. "[b]And we, the sons and daughters of the Pantagrueli motherland, humbly accept this noble hospitality. I aspire that a bond of strength be forged between our nations, one that shall remain unbroken under the sacred mantle of our shared virtue, so that we may stand as the very paragon of brotherhood.[/b]"  [/i]
Map update later today!
